name: Fruit Salad
body:
Station and Complexity garde manger 2

Flavor Profiles sweet, sour
Additional Ingredients sour, sweet, or texture

EFFECT

Duration 1 minute/level; Serving Size 1d6

DESCRIPTION

Fruit salad is a mix of fruit cut in little pieces and sprinkled with citrus juice. Sometimes liquor or sugar can be added to taste.

When consumed, fruit salad grants a +2 enhancement bonus on Linguistics and Sleight of Hand checks for the duration.

Additional ingredients increase the bonus and serving size by +1 each, to a maximum of +1 per level.
